text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text states Switzerland \"incorporated into national law\" the Cassis de Dijon principle through the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade, while French text only says Switzerland \"applies\" the principle autonomously without mentioning incorporation into national law.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "Switzerland autonomously introduced, and incorporated into national law through the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade, the \"Cassis de Dijon principle\"", "before": "«Cassis de Dijon principle\""}, "tgt": {"quote": "La Suisse applique de manière autonome le principe Cassis de Dijon", "before": "principe Cassis de Dijon"}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "English text mentions \"art. 16a of the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade\" as the legal basis, while French text mentions \"art. 16a LETC\" but does not explicitly link it to the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade in the same sentence.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "may in principle be placed on the Swiss market without any further controls (art. 16a of the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade)", "before": "controls ("}, "tgt": {"quote": "sans contrôle préalable (art. 16a LETC)", "before": "commercialisés librement en Suisse sans"}, "severity": 0.4}, {"reason": "French text adds a clarification that \"Only exceptions protecting overriding public interests are allowed\" which is not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "en": null, "tgt": {"quote": "Seules les exceptions destinées à protéger des intérêts publics prépondérants sont admises", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}]}
